"""Adaptive component diagnostics on spent target-isolation layouts; no task-score claim."""
import argparse,json
import numpy as np
from dojo.simlab import paths
from dojo.simlab.runner import RoboDojoRunner
from dojo.skills.env import RunnerEnv
from dojo.skills.skills import Skills,GTProvider,SkillResult
from dojo.skills.world import AssetDB
from dojo.skills import basket_transfer as T,basket_first as B,interactive as I
from dojo.skills.geometry import inv_T
ap=argparse.ArgumentParser();ap.add_argument('--modes',nargs='+',required=True);ap.add_argument('--name',required=True);a=ap.parse_args()
import byimg_r3_lead
byimg_r3_lead.install()
out=paths.DATA/a.name;out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
r=RoboDojoRunner('pick_from_conveyor_by_image',physics_only=True,need_planner=False,workdir=str(out/'work'));assets=AssetDB(paths.OBJECTS)
mode='';record={};z0=0
oldtranslate=B.translate;oldchoose=T.choose_arms;oldtarget=T.pick_target
B.translate=lambda sk,arm,dz,name,hold=5:True if name=='lower in air' else oldtranslate(sk,arm,dz,name,hold)
def choose(sk,target,container,v,ignore):
 if mode.endswith('75'):return oldchoose(sk,target,container,v,ignore)
 arms=None
 if 'down' in mode:arms=[max(('left','right'),key=lambda arm:sk.kin.base(arm)[:2,3]@v)]
 plan=I.plan_intercept(sk,target,v,t_min=100,t_max=600 if arms else 250,lift=I.target_lift(sk),arms=arms,ignore=tuple(ignore)+(container,))
 if plan is None:return oldchoose(sk,target,container,v,ignore)
 return ('right' if plan[0]=='left' else 'left'),plan[0]
T.choose_arms=oldchoose

def match_pick(sk,target,container,v,picker,ignore):
 if mode.startswith('container'):return oldtarget(sk,target,container,v,picker,ignore)
 oldc=sk.belt_container;oldw=getattr(sk,'belt_waist_first',None);failed=None
 try:
  sk.belt_container='off'
  result=I.pick_from_belt(sk,target,v,lift=.125,arms=[picker],ignore=tuple(ignore)+(container,))
  if result.ok or result.status!='grasp_slip':return result
  failed=getattr(sk,'notes_belt_method',None);sk.home(arms=[picker],gripper=1.)
  sk.belt_container='on';sk.belt_waist_first='on'
  return I.pick_from_belt(sk,target,v,lift=.125,arms=[picker],ignore=tuple(ignore)+(container,),skip_methods=(failed,) if failed else ())
 finally:
  sk.belt_container=oldc
  if oldw is None:sk.__dict__.pop('belt_waist_first',None)
  else:sk.belt_waist_first=oldw
def lead_pick(sk,*args):
 target,container,v,picker,ignore=args
 obj=sk.refresh().obj(target);sk.r3_lead=24 if obj.top_z-obj.bottom_z<.030 else 0
 before=sk.ex.steps_used
 try:
  result=oldtarget(sk,*args)
  if result.status=='ik_fail' and sk.ex.steps_used==before:
   result=I.pick_from_belt(sk,target,v,lift=.125,pull=.10,arms=[picker],ignore=tuple(ignore)+(container,))
  return result
 finally:sk.__dict__.pop('r3_lead',None)
T.pick_target=lead_pick
oldpick=I.pick_from_belt

def picked(sk,label,*args,**kw):
 if label!='target':return oldpick(sk,label,*args,**kw)
 w=sk.refresh();row=dict(step=sk.ex.steps_used,pos=w.obj(label).pos.tolist(),arms=kw.get('arms'),container_family=sk.belt_container)
 result=oldpick(sk,label,*args,**kw);row['result']=vars(result);row['method']=getattr(sk,'notes_belt_method',None);row['fingers']=sk.env.finger_joints();record.setdefault('attempts',[]).append(row);return result
I.pick_from_belt=picked

def stop(sk,arm,target,container,ignore):
 w=sk.refresh();before=inv_T(sk.kin.tcp(arm,w.arms[arm].q))@w.obj(target).T
 record['before_hold']=dict(rise=float(w.obj(target).pos[2]-z0),target=w.obj(target).pos.tolist(),finger_q=sk.env.finger_joints()[arm],picker=arm)
 sk.ex.hold(10);w=sk.refresh();after=inv_T(sk.kin.tcp(arm,w.arms[arm].q))@w.obj(target).T
 record['after_hold']=dict(rise=float(w.obj(target).pos[2]-z0),target=w.obj(target).pos.tolist(),finger_q=sk.env.finger_joints()[arm],relative_shift=float(np.linalg.norm(after[:3,3]-before[:3,3])))
 return SkillResult(False,'basket_drop','probe_stop',0,arm,note='target isolation complete')
T.drop_inset=stop
for seed in range(100080,100090):
 for mode in a.modes:
  layout=json.loads((paths.LAYOUTS/'pick_from_conveyor_by_image'/f'{seed}.json').read_text());info=r.load(layout);e=RunnerEnv(r);logs=[];record={};sk=Skills(e,GTProvider(e,assets),reserve=30,log=logs.append)
  sk.belt_first=sk.belt_first_recover=sk.belt_first_phase='on';sk.belt_target='match';z0=float(sk.world.obj('target').pos[2])
  result=I.pick_into_held(sk,['target','object1','object2','object3'],'basket','photo','conveyor')
  row=dict(seed=seed,mode=mode,stable=info['stable'],result=result,steps=sk.ex.steps_used,log=logs,**record)
  row['target_hold_ok']=bool(record.get('before_hold',{}).get('rise',0)>.075 and record.get('after_hold',{}).get('rise',0)>.075)
  with (out/'rows.jsonl').open('a') as f:f.write(json.dumps(row,default=str)+'\n')
  print('TARGET_MATRIX',seed,mode,row['target_hold_ok'],result,flush=True)
r.close()

"""Development-only motion diagnostics, with explicitly unscored post-latch continuation."""
import argparse,gzip,json
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from dojo.simlab import paths
from dojo.simlab.runner import RoboDojoRunner
from dojo.skills.env import RunnerEnv
from dojo.skills.skills import Skills,GTProvider
from dojo.skills.world import AssetDB
from dojo.skills import basket_first as B, interactive as I
from dojo.skills.executor import EpisodeEnded,BudgetExceeded
from dojo.skills.geometry import inv_T
ap=argparse.ArgumentParser();ap.add_argument('--ids',nargs='+',type=int,required=True);ap.add_argument('--name',default='diagnose');ap.add_argument('--continue-latch',action='store_true');ap.add_argument('--variant',default='base');a=ap.parse_args()
out=paths.DATA/a.name;out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
r=RoboDojoRunner('pick_from_conveyor_by_image',physics_only=True,need_planner=False,workdir=str(out/'work'));assets=AssetDB(paths.OBJECTS)
for seed in a.ids:
 root=Path.home()/'dojo-data/byimg/r2/simlab/layouts/pick_from_conveyor_by_image'
 p=root/f'{seed}.settled.json';p=p if p.exists() else root/f'{seed}.json'
 layout=json.loads(p.read_text());layout['_simlab']['seed']=seed
 info=r.load(layout);env=RunnerEnv(r);logs=[];frames=[];stage=['init'];latches=[]
 original_end=r.env.is_episode_end
 if a.continue_latch:
  def diagnostic_end(*args,**kw):
   result=original_end(*args,**kw)
   if r.env.end_flag[0] and r.env.success[0] and env.steps_used<env.step_lim:
    if not latches:latches.append(env.steps_used)
    r.env.end_flag[0]=False
    return False
   return result
  r.env.is_episode_end=diagnostic_end
 sk=Skills(env,GTProvider(env,assets),reserve=30,log=logs.append);sk.belt_first='on';sk.belt_target='match'
 if a.variant!='base':
  import byimg_r3_variants
  byimg_r3_variants.install(sk,a.variant)
 for method in ('run','run_lists'):
  original=getattr(sk.ex,method)
  def wrap(*args,_f=original,**kw):
   stage[0]=kw.get('name','');return _f(*args,**kw)
  setattr(sk.ex,method,wrap)
 def record(ex):
  w=sk.refresh();t=w.obj('target');b=w.obj('basket');tcp={k:sk.kin.tcp(k,w.arms[k].q) for k in ('left','right')}
  frames.append(dict(step=ex.steps_used,stage=stage[0],target=t.T.tolist(),basket=b.T.tolist(),target_bottom=t.bottom_z,basket_bottom=b.bottom_z,tcp={k:v.tolist() for k,v in tcp.items()},rel={k:(inv_T(v)@t.T).tolist() for k,v in tcp.items()},q={k:w.arms[k].q.tolist() for k in tcp},g=dict(ex.g),fingers=env.finger_joints()))
 sk.ex.on_step=record;record(sk.ex)
 try:res=I.pick_into_held(sk,['target','object1','object2','object3'],'basket','photo','conveyor')
 except (EpisodeEnded,BudgetExceeded) as exc:res=dict(exception=str(exc))
 if a.continue_latch:
  try:stage[0]='post_chain_hold';sk.ex.hold(min(100,sk.ex.steps_left-31))
  except (EpisodeEnded,BudgetExceeded):pass
 w=sk.refresh();rec=dict(seed=seed,variant=a.variant,diagnostic_continuation=a.continue_latch,stable=info['stable'],result=res,log=logs,score=r.score(),reward=r.reward(),latches=latches,steps=sk.ex.steps_used,final={k:dict(pos=w.obj(k).pos.tolist(),bottom=w.obj(k).bottom_z) for k in ('basket','target')})
 with gzip.open(out/f'{seed}.trace.json.gz','wt') as f:json.dump(frames,f)
 with (out/'rows.jsonl').open('a') as f:f.write(json.dumps(rec,default=str)+'\n')
 print('DIAGNOSTIC',json.dumps(rec,default=str),flush=True)
 if a.continue_latch:r.env.is_episode_end=original_end
r.close()

 if not first.ok:record['reject']=dict(stage='pre',status=first.status,note=first.note,goal=t.tolist());return SkillResult(False,'tray',first.status,0,arm)
 sk.ex.run({arm:ArmPlan(arm,sk.ex.q[arm].copy(),profile['g']).grip(profile['g'],3).move(first)},name='tray pre')
 n=sk.ex.settle(tol=.005,max_steps=100);record['pre_settle']=dict(steps=n,lag=sk.ex.lag())

 t=sk.kin.tcp(arm,sk.ex.q[arm]).copy();t[2,3]+=.04

 if mode.endswith('75'):return oldchoose(sk,target,container,v,ignore)
 arms=None
 if 'down' in mode:arms=[max(('left','right'),key=lambda arm:sk.kin.base(arm)[:2,3]@v)]
 plan=I.plan_intercept(sk,target,v,t_min=100,t_max=600 if arms else 250,lift=I.target_lift(sk),arms=arms,ignore=tuple(ignore)+(container,))
 if plan is None:return oldchoose(sk,target,container,v,ignore)

 if mode.startswith('container'):return oldtarget(sk,target,container,v,picker,ignore)

 finally:

 result=oldpick(sk,label,*args,**kw);row['result']=vars(result);row['method']=getattr(sk,'notes_belt_method',None);row['fingers']=sk.env.finger_joints();record.setdefault('attempts',[]).append(row);return result

import numpy as np
from dojo.skills import basket_first as B
from dojo.skills.executor import ArmPlan
from dojo.skills.geometry import inv_T
from dojo.skills.motion import held_box
from dojo.skills.skills import Held,SkillResult

def near_drop(sk,arm,label,container,ignore):
 w=sk.refresh();h=sk.held[arm];c=w.obj(container);o=w.obj(label)
 tcp=sk.kin.tcp(arm,w.arms[arm].q);rel=inv_T(tcp)@o.T
 vertices=np.asarray(o.asset.mesh[0]);points=(tcp[:3,:3]@(rel[:3,:3]@vertices.T+rel[:3,3:4])).T
 center=(points.max(0)+points.min(0))/2;half=(points.max(0)-points.min(0))/2
 rim=B.G.box_rim_z(np.asarray(c.asset.mesh[0]));mid=(c.asset.bbox_min+c.asset.bbox_max)/2;mid[2]=rim;p=c.pos+c.R@mid
 toward=sk.kin.base(arm)[:2,3]-p[:2];toward/=np.linalg.norm(toward)
 candidates=[]
 for shift in (.08,.04,.0):
  for extra_y in (.04,.0,-.04):
   desired=p.copy();desired[:2]+=shift*toward;desired[1]+=extra_y
   # Require projected target bbox to fit strictly inside the public container bbox.
   loc=c.R.T@(desired-c.pos);extent=np.abs(c.R).T@half
   if np.any(loc[:2]-extent[:2]<c.asset.bbox_min[:2]+.015) or np.any(loc[:2]+extent[:2]>c.asset.bbox_max[:2]-.015):continue
   goal=tcp.copy();goal[:3,3]=[desired[0]-center[0],desired[1]-center[1],desired[2]+.015-points[:,2].min()]
   waypoint=tcp.copy();waypoint[:2,3]=.5*(tcp[:2,3]+goal[:2,3]);waypoint[2,3]=max(tcp[2,3],goal[2,3])+.005
   first=sk.motion.line(arm,sk.ex.q[arm],waypoint,.025,'clear_rim',gripper=0.,held=held_box(o,rel),ignore=tuple(ignore)+(label,container))
   if not first.ok:continue
   second=sk.motion.line(arm,first.q_end,goal,.025,'near_rim_drop',gripper=0.,held=held_box(o,rel),ignore=tuple(ignore)+(label,container))
   if second.ok:candidates.append((first.steps+second.steps,first,second,desired))
 if not candidates:return SkillResult(False,'basket_drop','no_plan',0,arm,note='no fixed-wrist inset drop')
 _,first,second,desired=min(candidates,key=lambda r:r[0]);sk.log('[near-drop] '+str(desired.tolist()))
 for mv in (first,second):
  for seg in mv.segments:seg.ease=4
 sk.ex.run({arm:ArmPlan(arm,sk.ex.q[arm].copy(),0.).hold(6)},name='squeeze check')
 w=sk.refresh();r0=inv_T(sk.kin.tcp(arm,w.arms[arm].q))@w.obj(label).T
 if np.linalg.norm(r0[:3,3]-rel[:3,3])>.02:return SkillResult(False,'basket_drop','grasp_slip',0,arm,note='drift during squeeze')
 sk.ex.run({arm:ArmPlan(arm,sk.ex.q[arm].copy(),0.).move(first).move(second).hold(3)},name='fixed wrist inset carry')
 w=sk.refresh();newrel=inv_T(sk.kin.tcp(arm,w.arms[arm].q))@w.obj(label).T
 if np.linalg.norm(newrel[:3,3]-rel[:3,3])>.04:return SkillResult(False,'basket_drop','grasp_slip',0,arm,note='attachment lost during carry')
 # Correct the measured target, without introducing a wrist rotation.
 delta=desired[:2]-w.obj(label).center_w[:2]
 if np.linalg.norm(delta)>.04:return SkillResult(False,'basket_drop','grasp_slip',0,arm,note='drop alignment drift')
 if np.linalg.norm(delta)>.003:
  T=sk.kin.tcp(arm,sk.ex.q[arm]).copy();T[:2,3]+=delta
  mv=sk.motion.line(arm,sk.ex.q[arm],T,.025,'near_correct',gripper=0.,check=False)
  if not mv.ok:return SkillResult(False,'basket_drop','no_plan',0,arm,note='correction unreachable')
  sk.ex.run({arm:ArmPlan(arm,sk.ex.q[arm].copy(),0.).move(mv).hold(2)},name='near correct')
 sk.ex.run({arm:ArmPlan(arm,sk.ex.q[arm].copy(),0.).grip(1.,3).hold(25)},name='release inset')
 sk.held[arm]=None
 return SkillResult(True,'basket_drop','ok',0,arm)

"""Raise the empty basket under the retained target, release, then hold still."""
import inspect
import numpy as np
from dojo.skills import basket_first as B,basket_transfer as T
from dojo.skills.executor import ArmPlan
from dojo.skills.geometry import inv_T,rot_z
from dojo.skills.skills import SkillResult

def release(sk,arm,label,container,ignore):
 holder=next(a for a,h in sk.held.items() if h is not None and h.label==container)
 w=sk.refresh();c=w.obj(container);o=w.obj(label);before=inv_T(sk.kin.tcp(arm,w.arms[arm].q))@o.T
 xy=c.pos[:2].copy();xy[0]+=sk.r3_offset;yaw=np.arctan2(c.R[1,0],c.R[0,0]);height=sk.kin.base(holder)[2,3]+.125
 sk.log('[pre-release basket] offset '+str(sk.r3_offset))
 reached=False;bottom=c.bottom_z;tilt=90.
 for _ in range(6):
  reached,bottom,tilt=B.level_hold(sk,container,holder,rot_z(yaw),xy,height)
  if reached and bottom>sk.kin.base(holder)[2,3]+.09 and tilt<12.:break
 if not reached or bottom<sk.kin.base(holder)[2,3]+.09 or tilt>=12.:return SkillResult(False,'pre_release','no_plan',0,arm,note='no elevated empty-basket hold')
 w=sk.refresh();c=w.obj(container);o=w.obj(label);after=inv_T(sk.kin.tcp(arm,w.arms[arm].q))@o.T;drift=float(np.linalg.norm(after[:3,3]-before[:3,3]));sk.log('[pre-release basket] target drift '+str(drift))
 if drift>.03:return SkillResult(False,'pre_release','grasp_slip',0,arm,note='target disturbed by raised basket')
 v=(o.R@np.asarray(o.asset.mesh[0]).T).T+o.pos;local=(c.R.T@(v-c.pos).T).T
 low=c.asset.bbox_min[:2]+.010-local[:,:2].min(0);high=c.asset.bbox_max[:2]-.010-local[:,:2].max(0)
 if np.any(low>high):return SkillResult(False,'pre_release','alignment',0,arm,note='target too wide')
 shift=np.minimum(np.maximum(np.zeros(2),low),high)
 if np.linalg.norm(shift)>.002:
  delta=c.R[:3,:2]@shift;goal=sk.kin.tcp(arm,w.arms[arm].q).copy();goal[:3,3]+=delta
  move=sk.motion.line(arm,sk.ex.q[arm],goal,.015,'raised_alignment',gripper=0.,check=False)
  if not move.ok:return SkillResult(False,'pre_release','alignment',0,arm,note='raised alignment IK')
  sk.ex.run({arm:ArmPlan(arm,sk.ex.q[arm].copy(),0.).move(move).hold(10)},name='align over raised basket')
  sk.log('[pre-release alignment] '+str(delta.tolist()))

"""Freeze belt-relative rests without adding a second reset's belt travel.

Run in RoboDojo's Python inside the normal physics-only resource wrapper.
Unlike round 1, common horizontal displacement is measured from authored poses.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import copy
import json

import numpy as np


def remove_phase(live):
    riders = [
        o
        for o in live
        if o["type"] == "Rigid"
        and not o["clutter"]
        and o.get("pos") is not None
        and o.get("layout_pos") is not None
    ]
    if not riders:
        raise ValueError("no riders with authored poses")
    shift = np.median([np.subtract(o["pos"], o["layout_pos"]) for o in riders], axis=0)
    shift[2] = 0.0
    corrected = copy.deepcopy(live)
    for o in corrected:
        if o["type"] == "Rigid" and o.get("pos") is not None:
            o["pos"] = np.subtract(o["pos"], shift).tolist()
    return corrected, shift


def main():
    from dojo.simlab import paths
    from dojo.simlab.presettle import raw_at_rest, write_back
    from dojo.simlab.runner import RoboDojoRunner

    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(__doc__)
    ap.add_argument("--task", default="pick_from_conveyor_by_image")
    ap.add_argument("--ids", nargs="+", type=int, required=True)
    a = ap.parse_args()
    if any(i < paths.SEED_BASE or paths.is_reserved_id(i) for i in a.ids):
        raise SystemExit("only unreserved dev ids")
    root = paths.LAYOUTS / a.task
    paths.assert_not_eval(root)
    runner = RoboDojoRunner(
        a.task,
        physics_only=True,
        need_planner=False,
        workdir=str(paths.DATA / "native-phase-settle-work"),
    )
    index_path = root / "settled_index.json"
    index = json.loads(index_path.read_text()) if index_path.exists() else {}
    try:
        for seed in a.ids:
            layout = json.loads((root / f"{seed}.json").read_text())
            info = runner.load(layout)
            for _ in range(150):
                runner.env.sim_step(render=False)
            before = runner.objects_gt()
            for _ in range(100):
                runner.env.sim_step(render=False)
            live = runner.objects_gt()
            ok, why, window = raw_at_rest(before, live, False)
            corrected, shift = remove_phase(live)
            settled, _ = write_back(layout, corrected)
            settled["_simlab"]["presettle"] = "belt-native-phase-v2"
            reload = runner.load(settled)
            status = "ok" if ok and info["stable"] and reload["stable"] else "dropped"
            index[str(seed)] = dict(
                status=status,
                why=why,
                phase_translation_m=shift.tolist(),
                belt_window_m=window,
            )
            if status == "ok":
                (root / f"{seed}.settled.json").write_text(
                    json.dumps(settled, indent=1)
                )
            index_path.write_text(json.dumps(index, indent=1))
            print("NATIVE_PHASE_SETTLE", seed, index[str(seed)], flush=True)
    finally:
        runner.close()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Adaptive development probes; never used for registered panel execution."""
import inspect,json
import numpy as np
from dojo.skills import basket_first as B, interactive as I
from dojo.skills.executor import ArmPlan

from dojo.skills.motion import held_box,Segment
from dojo.skills.skills import Held,SkillResult
original_drop=B.drop_center
original_lift=B.lift_first
original_pick=I.pick_from_belt

def under_drop(sk,arm,label,container,ignore):
 w=sk.refresh();holder=next(a for a,h in sk.held.items() if h is not None and h.label==container)
 h=sk.held[arm];o=w.obj(label);c=w.obj(container)
 tcp=sk.kin.tcp(arm,w.arms[arm].q);rel=inv_T(tcp)@o.T
 # Preserve the measured wrist/attachment, rather than the pre-lift attachment.
 h=sk.held[arm]=Held(label,rel,held_box(o,rel),h.grasp)
 R0=c.R.copy();rim=B.G.box_rim_z(np.asarray(c.asset.mesh[0]));bottom=c.bottom_z
 mid=(c.asset.bbox_min+c.asset.bbox_max)/2;mid[2]=rim
 target_center=o.center_w.copy();cshift=c.center_w[:2]-c.pos[:2]
 plans=[]
 for x in (target_center[0],-.20,-.15,-.10,-.05,.0,.05):
  for y in (target_center[1],-.12,-.18):
   desired=c.T.copy();desired[:2,3]=[x-cshift[0],y-cshift[1]]
   # Bring rim 20 mm below the held target without lowering below baseline's airborne bottom.
   desired[2,3]+=max(-.05,min(0.,o.bottom_z-.02-(c.pos+c.R@mid)[2]))
   crel=inv_T(sk.kin.tcp(holder,w.arms[holder].q))@c.T
   cg=desired@inv_T(crel)
   cm=sk.motion.to_pose(holder,sk.ex.q[holder],cg,.035,'basket_under',gripper=0.,check=False)
   if not cm.ok:continue
   points=(tcp[:3,:3]@(rel[:3,:3]@np.asarray(o.asset.mesh[0]).T+rel[:3,3:4])).T
   cen=(points.max(0)+points.min(0))/2;p=desired[:3,3]+desired[:3,:3]@mid
   goal=tcp.copy();goal[:3,3]=[p[0]-cen[0],p[1]-cen[1],p[2]+.015-points[:,2].min()]
   tm=sk.motion.line(arm,sk.ex.q[arm],goal,.035,'fixed_wrist_drop',gripper=0.,held=h.box,ignore=tuple(ignore)+(label,container))
   if tm.ok:plans.append((float(np.linalg.norm(goal[:3,3]-tcp[:3,3])),cm,tm))
 if not plans:return SkillResult(False,'basket_drop','no_plan',0,arm,note='no basket-under pair')
 distance,cm,tm=min(plans,key=lambda p:p[0]);sk.log('[under-plan] '+str(distance))
 for mv in (cm,tm):
  for seg in mv.segments:seg.ease=4
 sk.ex.run({holder:ArmPlan(holder,sk.ex.q[holder].copy(),0.).move(cm).hold(5)},name='basket under target')
 sk.ex.run({arm:ArmPlan(arm,sk.ex.q[arm].copy(),0.).hold(6)},name='pre-drop squeeze')
 w=sk.refresh();newrel=inv_T(sk.kin.tcp(arm,w.arms[arm].q))@w.obj(label).T
 if np.linalg.norm(newrel[:3,3]-rel[:3,3])>.025:return SkillResult(False,'basket_drop','grasp_slip',0,arm,note='squeeze drift')
 sk.ex.run({arm:ArmPlan(arm,sk.ex.q[arm].copy(),0.).move(tm).hold(3)},name='fixed wrist carry')
 w=sk.refresh();delta=w.obj(container).center_w[:2]-w.obj(label).center_w[:2]
 if np.linalg.norm(delta)>.07:return SkillResult(False,'basket_drop','grasp_slip',0,arm,note='target lost before release')
 sk.ex.run({arm:ArmPlan(arm,sk.ex.q[arm].copy(),0.).grip(1.,3).hold(25)},name='release center')
 sk.held[arm]=None
 return SkillResult(True,'basket_drop','ok',0,arm)

def retry_pick(sk,label,v,**kw):
 result=original_pick(sk,label,v,**kw)
 if label=='target' and not result.ok:
  failed=getattr(sk,'notes_belt_method',None)
  sk.home(arms=kw['arms'],gripper=1.)
  old=sk.belt_waist_first;sk.belt_waist_first='on'
  try:result=original_pick(sk,label,v,**kw,skip_methods=(failed,) if failed else ())
  finally:sk.belt_waist_first=old
 return result

def install(sk,variant):
 if 'under' in variant:B.drop_center=under_drop
 if 'retry' in variant:I.pick_from_belt=retry_pick
 source=inspect.getsource(original_lift)
 if 'short' in variant:
  source=source.replace('                0.10,\n                ignore,\n                0.10,', '                0.06,\n                ignore,\n                0.10,').replace('lift=0.10,','lift=0.06,').replace('for _ in range(4):','for _ in range(2):')
 if 'under' in variant:source=source.replace('translate(sk, holder, -0.05, "lower in air")','pass  # basket-under selects the airborne lowering')
 if 'partial' in variant:source=source.replace('lift=I.target_lift(sk),','lift=I.target_lift(sk),\n                min_rise=0.04,')
 namespace=dict(B.__dict__);exec(source,namespace);B.lift_first=namespace['lift_first']

disk_guard byimg
who >> "$DOJO_DATA/logs/$name.admission"
nvidia-smi --query-compute-apps=pid,process_name,used_memory --format=csv >> "$DOJO_DATA/logs/$name.admission"
used=$(nvidia-smi --query-gpu=memory.used --format=csv,noheader,nounits)
avail=$(awk '/MemAvailable/ {print int($2/1048576)}' /proc/meminfo)
printf 'time=%s used_MB=%s available_GB=%s\n' "$(date -u +%FT%TZ)" "$used" "$avail" >> "$DOJO_DATA/logs/$name.admission"
[[ "$used" -le 24576 && "$avail" -ge 25 ]] || exit 75
printf 'pid=%s stream=BYIMG start=%s\n' "$$" "$(date -u +%FT%TZ)" > "$HOME/$lock"
exec timeout -k 60 1800 systemd-run --user --scope -q -p MemoryMax=8G -p CPUQuota=600% scripts/simlab/rdpy.sh -u -m "$@"
